camel_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost CreateHost --region cn-hangzhou --ActiveAddressType Public --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --OSType Linux --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostName host01 --Source Local
description_en: Creates a host in a Bastionhost instance. Bastionhost supports O&M for hosts from different sources, including Alibaba Cloud ECS instances, on-premises IDC servers, and servers on other clouds. Before you perform O&M on a host through Bastionhost, you must first import the host into Bastionhost. You can call this operation to create a host that you want to manage in Bastionhost
description_zh: 堡垒机支持运维阿里云ECS服务器、线下IDC服务器以及其他云上服务器等不同来源的主机。在通过堡垒机运维主机之前，首先需要在堡垒机中导入主机。您可以参考本接口在堡垒机中创建需要运维的主机
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-host --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --active-address-type Public --host-name host01 --source Local --os-type Linux --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateHost

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance where you want to create the host.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建主机所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance where you want to create the host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建主机所在堡垒机的地域ID。
Region ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The private network address of the host to create. You can specify a domain name or an IP address.
This parameter is required if ActiveAddressType is set to Private
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建主机的私网地址，可使用域名或IP地址。
ActiveAddressType选择Private时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: host_private_address

parameters.help_en:
The public address of the host to create. You can specify a domain name or an IP address.
This parameter is required if ActiveAddressType is set to Public
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建主机的公网地址，可使用域名或IP地址。
ActiveAddressType选择Public时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: host_public_address

parameters.help_en:
The address type of the host to create. Valid values:
Public: public address.
Private: private network address
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建主机的地址类型。取值：
Public：公网地址
Private：私网地址
parameters.name: active_address_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the host to create. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定新创建主机的名称，最多支持128字符
parameters.name: host_name

parameters.help_en:
The source of the host to create. Valid values:
Local: on-premises host.
Ecs: ECS instance.
Rds: ApsaraDB RDS dedicated cluster host
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建主机的来源。取值：
Local：本地主机
Ecs：ECS实例
Rds：RDS专属集群主机
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The operating system of the host to create. Valid values:
Linux
Windows
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建主机的操作系统。取值：
Linux
Windows
parameters.name: os_type

parameters.help_en: The description of the host. The description can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定主机的备注信息，最多支持500字符
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the ECS instance or dedicated cluster host.  
This parameter is required if Source is set to Ecs or Rds
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建的ECS实例ID或专属集群主机ID。  
Source选择Ecs或Rds时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: source_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the ECS instance or dedicated cluster host.  
This parameter is required if Source is set to Ecs or Rds
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建的ECS实例或专属集群主机所属区域ID。  
Source选择Ecs或Rds时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: instance_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the network domain to which the host to create belongs.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.html to query the network domain ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建主机所属的网络域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: network_domain_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the ECS instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 指定新创建的ECS实例所属的主账号ID
parameters.name: instance_member_id

HostId.description_en: The ID of the host that was created

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
